title: corp-infra VPS provider policy
description: bootstrap/providers/<id>.json. Provider constraints expressed as CONFIG so that no script has to change when a verdict changes (plan section 9.1). Sources are cited as relative paths into research/.

vpn_hub_allowed.description: false means install-wireguard.sh refuses hub_role=self with exit 1 (plan section 9.1).

outbound_portscan_allowed.description: Always honoured as false in code: no corp-infra script ever scans a foreign host.

default_sg_open.description: true when the provider default security group exposes 22/3389 to the internet.

conditionally_blocked_ports_tcp.description: Ports the vendor describes with 'may be blocked' modality, in specific locations only.

notes_ref.description: Relative path (plus section) into research/ that justifies these values. No external URLs here.
